text: asked QD3-004: QD3-004. You answered QD3-003 'Backward', and I am re-ruling the closed groups' add-condition and add-step lines under G4a by appended lines. One more scope question. At D3a-10 I also cited G4a on P16's 33 link lines, though G4a as written covers only add-condition and add-step lines; I extended it without a dated amendment, which your drift ruling forbids. The closed groups hold about 470 link lines (P01 60, P02 84, P05 93, P04 39, P12 24, P22 3, K01 5, P03 138, P11 23), most ruled paired elaborations under G4. Some name an arrow whose connection or bound already states the link: P11's links where the record comes before the marking name A08's bound (belgium-056). Should I amend G4a to cover link lines and apply it backwards to them as well, or should link lines stay under G4 as ruled, with P16's 33 links re-ruled to match the earlier groups? | meanwhile: Meanwhile every link ruling stands as it is, P16's included; I re-rule only add-condition and add-step lines, as QD3-003 asked, and record the D3a-10 extension to links as a slip

QD3-004 answered by J: 'Amend G4a to cover link lines and apply it backwards to them as well.' My meanwhile assumption, that every link ruling stands, is replaced. G4a is amended (dated 18 October, D3a-11) to cover link lines: a link whose relation the element's statement or range, another element's statement or range, or an arrow's connection, bound or mechanism already states is a specification naming that id; a link no part of the model states stays a paired elaboration or a particular. It applies backwards to the closed groups' link lines (P01 60, P02 84, P05 93, P04 39, P12 24, P22 3, K01 5, P03 138, P11 23), by appended re-rulings under the same rules as the add lines. P16's 33 links were ruled under G4a at D3a-10 and stand; the D3a-10 slip is now covered by the amendment. Backward pass so far: R01 1, P01 10, P02 68 (3 of them re-pairings, kind kept) and P05 112 re-rulings, checked; written to the ledger now
